profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Passionate software engineer and tinkerer with a deep interest in software systems, from bare-metal embedded to high-level business applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led & completed a rewrite (Scala to Java) of business-critical quoting tool with ~80 peak concurrent users, among other greenfield SaaS-like projects.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Full-stack software development for in-house business solutions supporting military and government sales (e.g. quote builder, sales travel logger, Salesforce and Oracle integrations). Lead maintainer of a mission-critical application.

positions.title: Co-Founder, Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a wildlife exploration game that encourages kids to engage with nature around them. Completed prototyping, PCB design, embedded software, and short-run production for a custom nRF52833 board and a custom ESP32 board.

Made in collaboration with the Hendrickson Lab at The University of Texas at Austin and the San Antonio Zoo.
positions.insights: Skills: Bluetooth Low Energy · Early-Stage Startups

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed full-stack for a mineral analytics platform that evaluates a client company's current mineral rights portfolio and pending deals to significantly accelerate the company's overall acquisition process.

- Implemented ETL jobs for importing and scrubbing state data using Django and Polars
- Wireframed and implemented an in-map well spacing unit editor with React and Material UI
- Documented REST APIs using OpenAPI
- Project concluded due to merger with Sitio Royalties

positions.title: Shared Platform Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Maintained a Big Data platform that allows B2B companies to clean and enrich their information about other businesses.

- Architected a customer-facing API for matching freeform data against a data warehouse, optimized for subsecond latency
- Fixed bugs and added features for a high-throughput data pipeline using Apache Spark
- Responded to live production-level issues and coordinated fixes
- Discovered and suggested opportunities for overall platform improvements (e.g. AOP-based tracing and instrumentation; replacing various ETL processes with Amazon Athena; tuning memory usage to cut Elastic MapReduce costs by tens of thousands a year)
- Awarded Rookie of the Year 2021
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Spark · Amazon Athena · Splunk · Java · MySQL · Git

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Collaborated globally with interns on a business analysis whitepaper and hackathon project involving the Visa Developer Platform, investigating ways to stimulate cash displacement during the COVID-19 pandemic.

positions.title: Chief of Software
positions.description: Oversaw all software aspects of the Phoenix III UAS, divided among three main subteams (Autopilot, Infrastructure, and Image Recognition).

positions.title: Infrastructure Team Lead
positions.description:
Taught advanced JavaScript paradigms to prospective org members in a three-week bootcamp and managed development relating to aircraft-ground communications in a scrum setting.
Participated in AUVSI SUAS 2019, with the team placing third in journal (out of 75) and scoring $1,250.

positions.title: Software Team Member
positions.description:
Collaborated in laying out a new microservices architecture for aircraft-ground communications using Node.js, Python, and Docker. Implemented a telemetry service that allows interfacing with an embedded autopilot module over a REST API.
Participated in AUVSI SUAS 2018, where our deliverable (Sir Vay Lance) placed 6th overall out of 69 teams, scoring $2,350 in prize money.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Held office/student hours, graded major programming projects and exams, answered online questions, and led weekly discussion sections for CS 439 under Dr. Alison Norman. This operating systems course has a notoriety in the department for its difficulty.

company.name: Department of Computer Science, The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Backend Intern
positions.description:
- Designed a high-performance enterprise notification service
- Fixed bugs for a FICO Xpress linear optimization model whose output became core source of revenue, as part of a large project that modernized the proposal workflow for radio advertisers in both digital and traditional markets
- Finished first place at the company hackathon with "Duet," an app that matches people by common music interests

positions.title: DevOps Intern
positions.description:
- Maintained an ever-expanding number of Jenkins pipelines
- Frontend (Angular) work for a large project that modernized the proposal workflow for radio advertisers
- Finished second place at the company hackathon with "iHeartParty"

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
Claudia Taylor "Lady Bird" Johnson High School

organizations.name: UAV Austin
organizations.position: Infrastructure Lead; Chief of Software · Sep 2017 - Jun 2020
organizations.description:
Worked on ground software for plane entered into the SUAS AUVSI competition in June 2018 (placed 6th with $2,350 in prize money) and in June 2019 (placed 14th place, 3rd in tech paper).
- Created telemetry service that polls autopilot data and simplifies the MAVLink protocol as a REST API
- Documented plane communications testing and cybersecurity evaluation
- Collaborated on software stack redesign and related issues
- Taught Node.js and ES6 to incoming members
